item.title: Tadej Pogacar wins Tour de France for a record-equalling fifth time
item.description: The Tour triumph marks the Slovenian's third win in a row and draws him level with four others on the all-time list

item.title: German arms export licences for Israel surge with focus on sub project
item.description: A dramatic rise in export permissions marks the latest twist in Germany's approach to ally Israel.

item.title: Iran warns Ukraine of retaliation after deadly Caspian Sea strike
item.description: Abbas Araghchi says the Ukrainian attack on the Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea 'cannot go unanswered'.

item.title: Climate change presents new threat to Philippines’ UNESCO rice terraces
item.description: Limited government resources undercut efforts of Ifugao people to safeguard heritage site from extreme weather effects.

item.title: Pakistan’s Kashmir votes: Why the election hinges on 12 disputed seats
item.description: The fight over refugee representation has revived longstanding questions about democracy, autonomy and political power.

item.title: Protests erupt in Libya’s Tripoli as anger grows over power cuts
item.description: Protesters shut roads and the foreign ministry in Tripoli as a civil disobedience campaign over power cuts spreads.

item.title: Firefighters battle wildfires in Spain’s eastern Castellon province
item.description: Wildfires in Spain’s Castellon region have burnt more than 4,300 hectares and forced 15,000 residents to evacuate.

item.title: Thousands march in Pakistan-administered Kashmir amid election unrest
item.description: Thousands gathered in Rawalakot before marching towards Muzaffarabad in Pakistan-administered Kashmir.

item.title: Sudan’s army claims control of major highway linking Khartoum and el-Obeid
item.description: Capture of Al Sadarat highway will help the Sudanese army block the RSF's push to seize el-Obeid in North Kordofan.

item.title: Vendor’s livestream captures chaos as gunfire erupts at Seattle Center
item.description: A vendor livestreaming from the Bite of Seattle festival captured the moment shots rang out near the Space Needle.

item.title: Sudan’s army regains control of highway linking Khartoum with El Obeid
item.description: Sudan's army says it has regained full control of Al Sadarat highway linking Khartoum to El Obeid

item.title: Russia and Ukraine trade attacks, killing 10, including child in Chernihiv
item.description: Kyiv says Russian strikes killed six, including a child at a supermarket, as Moscow says Ukrainian strikes killed four.

item.title: Firefighters battle to contain wildfires still burning near Bordeaux
item.description: Wildfires in southwestern France are continuing to burn near the city of Bordeaux.

item.title: Why Mali’s northern conflict has entered a dangerous new phase
item.description: A separatist–al-Qaeda alliance has shifted the balance of power in northern Mali and complicated efforts to end the war.

item.title: Massive iceberg capsizes off the coast of Greenland
item.description: A massive iceberg capsized off the coast of Ilulissat, Greenland flipping with force to reveal its jagged underside.

item.title: Ebola infections in DR Congo surge to 3,200, with 1,405 deaths
item.description: Cases have surged by 1,000 in just 10 days as outbreak continues to spread across five provinces.

item.title: Lebanese return to homes of rubble left by Israel in so-called pilot zones
item.description: Lebanon's army has accused Israel of bulldozing homes and hindering its efforts to escort residents to 'pilot zones'.

item.title: Guterres tours Syria’s notorious ‘Assad Prison’ in Sednaya
item.description: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres toured the notorious former ‘Assad prison’ in Sednaya.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran halts retaliatory strikes after pause in US attacks
item.description: The US has paused its two-week bombing campaign against Iran, prompting Tehran to suspend its retaliatory attacks.

item.title: Khamenei ties US-Iran peace deal to Israel ending attacks on Lebanon
item.description: Iran's supreme leader calls for 'absolute, unconditional termination' of Israel's attacks on Lebanon.

item.title: Trump’s border czar probes possible vetting failures after ICE shooting
item.description: ICE officer under review for alleged mental health struggles, violent behavior amid deadly shooting case in Maine.

item.title: What’s causing the unprecedented wildfires in Europe?
item.description: France and Spain have deployed thousands of firefighters, and neighbouring countries have sent help.

item.title: Israeli government nods to international stabilisation force in Gaza
item.description: The ISF, to be staffed by 'friendly countries', will operate in areas outside of Israel's military control.

item.title: Palestinians hope international peace force can rebuild Gaza
item.description: Palestinians in Gaza cautiously welcome Israel’s approval for an international stabilisation force to enter the strip.

item.title: US and Iran hit pause on strikes for second day
item.description: The relative calm comes amid reports of renewed efforts to restore diplomatic talks.
